attr.title: Pocket Euclidean
attr.desc: A Euclidean rhythm groovebox for handhelds: eight tracks, sampler and synth voices, LFO and jitter modulation, and flat step-bar visuals.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Put your own mono .wav files in pocketeuclidean/samples (sorted by name, tracks 1-8); built-in sounds are used otherwise.
